reviewItem.question: Does "Store for retrieving remote schema: Previously LogCLI used to fetch remote schema from the store configured in `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store` when…" mean a change to cli-flag:loki|name=-boltdb.shipper.shared-store|component=logcli (renamed)?

proposed.statement: LogCLI no longer takes the remote schema store from -boltdb.shipper.shared-store when -remote-schema is true; the new -schema-store flag replaces it.
